quarterly_data.quarter: Realtek press release: Realtek Showcases Next-Generation AI Home Entertainment, (09-10-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Realtek said its 100GbE (25GbE x4) solutions, optimised for edge AI and internal enterprise servers, are now in mass production. Built on CMOS technology, they integrate TIA + LA + CDR on the receive side and CDR + VCSEL driver + MCU on the transmit side; the built-in MCU is meant to reduce overall system cost.
